mapper.select:
SELECT SESSION_ID, SESSION_NAME, REVIEW_TYPE, SESSION_STATUS, REMARK, CONTRACT_VERSION, CREATED_BY, CREATED_BY_NAME, SESSION_CREATED_AT, SESSION_UPDATED_AT, MATERIALS_CONFIRMED_AT, SESSION_VERSION_NO, DELETED_AT, DELETED_BY, CONTRACT_ID, CONTRACT_NO, CONTRACT_NAME, CONTRACT_TYPE, PARTY_A, PARTY_B, PARTY_B_CREDIT_CODE, CONTRACT_AMOUNT, AMOUNT_IN_WORDS, CONTRACT_STATUS, CONTRACT_VERSION_NO, CONTRACT_CREATED_AT, CONTRACT_UPDATED_AT FROM ( SELECT s.ID AS SESSION_ID, s.NAME AS SESSION_NAME, s.REVIEW_TYPE, s.STATUS AS SESSION_STATUS, s.REMARK, s.CONTRACT_VERSION, s.CREATED_BY, u.REAL_NAME AS CREATED_BY_NAME, s.CREATED_AT AS SESSION_CREATED_AT, s.UPDATED_AT AS SESSION_UPDATED_AT, s.MATERIALS_CONFIRMED_AT, s.VERSION_NO AS SESSION_VERSION_NO, s.DELETED_AT, s.DELETED_BY, c.ID AS CONTRACT_ID, c.CONTRACT_NO, c.CONTRACT_NAME, c.CONTRACT_TYPE, c.PARTY_A, c.PARTY_B, c.PARTY_B_CREDIT_CODE, c.CONTRACT_AMOUNT, c.AMOUNT_IN_WORDS, c.STATUS AS CONTRACT_STATUS, c.VERSION_NO AS CONTRACT_VERSION_NO, c.CREATED_AT AS CONTRACT_CREATED_AT, c.UPDATED_AT AS CONTRACT_UPDATED_AT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.CREATED_AT DESC, s.ID DESC) AS ROW_NO FROM CONTRACT_REVIEW_SESSION s JOIN CONTRACT c ON c.ID = s.CONTRACT_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_USER u ON u.ID = s.CREATED_BY
) PAGE_ROWS WHERE ROW_NO > #{offset} AND ROW_NO <= #{endRow} ORDER BY ROW_NO
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONTRACT_REVIEW_SESSION s JOIN CONTRACT c ON c.ID = s.CONTRACT_ID
